Green — `BUILD SUCCESS`, all tests pass.

## What I changed

The GET response is an `OwnerDto` generated from `openapi.yml` and populated by `OwnerMapper`, which already derives `displayName` via a `@Mapping` expression. I added `initials` the same way:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `initials` string property to the `Owner` schema (so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field).
2. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — one `@Mapping` line on `toOwnerDto`:
   ```java
   @Mapping(target = "initials", expression = "java(owner.getFirstName().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + \".\" + owner.getLastName().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + \".\")")
   ```
   `"john"`/`"smith"` → `"J.S."`.

## Why this keeps structural impact low

- I put the behaviour on `toOwnerDto`, whose cyclomatic complexity is 1 and whose surrounding class (a MapStruct interface of trivial abstract methods) has tiny `WMC_other` — instead of adding a method to the `Owner` entity, a large class whose `WMC_other` (the `getPet` loops, sorting, etc.) would have dominated the cost.
- The change is a single added annotation line (CC 1 × 1 line), across just 2 files, and mirrors the existing `displayName` convention exactly, so no new pattern was introduced.
